entries.description: Bounded public utilities for aadhar.sh over MCP at https://aadhar.sh/mcp: site search and NLWeb ask, the current playlist, the published photo archive and its exact Fuji recipes, coffee availability, the neighborhood Change Radar, Lens (how a machine sees any public URL), ephemeral image inspection and transforms, and an HTTP representation vault. Read-only except the vault's capture and compare tools, which say so in their annotations.
representativeQueries: what is aadharsh listening to right now
find a photo shot on the X-T50 with Classic Chrome
when can I grab coffee with aadharsh
show me what a crawler sees when it opens example.com
what did the encoder do to this JPEG

entries.description: Read-only MCP server at https://aadhar.sh/serendipity/mcp over the Serendipity event pool: community-curated events worth going to, who is going, and who keeps crossing paths with whom. Public data only.
representativeQueries: which events are on this week in the serendipity pool
who is going to this event
which people keep showing up at the same events
have these two people crossed paths at an event

entries.description: Discovery-only agent card in the A2A card format, naming every machine interface this host exposes: both MCP servers, the HTTP JSON endpoints, WebMCP, and optional anonymous agent registration. This host does not expose an A2A task endpoint; the card says so and points at the MCP and JSON interfaces instead.
representativeQueries: what machine interfaces does aadhar.sh expose
does aadhar.sh have an A2A endpoint
how does an agent authenticate to aadhar.sh

entries.description: A SKILL.md teaching an agent to query the Serendipity event pool over its public MCP server: which tools to call for events, attendees, contributors and co-attendance, and how to read the results.
representativeQueries: install a skill for querying the serendipity event pool
teach my agent to look up who is attending an event
how do I query serendipity events over MCP

entries.description: Natural-language questions over this site's corpus, answered as schema.org objects per the NLWeb convention. Parameters: query (required), streaming (defaults to an event stream; 0 for one JSON body), mode=list (summarize and generate answer 501, since this Worker has no model). The same function is the ask tool on the site MCP server.
representativeQueries: ask aadhar.sh a question in plain English
what is this site about
which pages on aadhar.sh talk about compression dictionaries

entries.description: The site summary written for agents: who runs aadhar.sh, every public page and its Markdown twin, every JSON endpoint, and the discovery files under /.well-known. Read this first.
representativeQueries: summarize what aadhar.sh is, for an agent
what does aadhar.sh publish for agents
which pages on aadhar.sh have markdown twins

entries.description: The RFC 9727 index of every JSON endpoint on aadhar.sh, each anchored to its service description and documentation: the photo manifest, the current playlist, public site search, the bounded photo query, coffee availability, the neighborhood crawl and Change Radar, and the compact Lens comparison.
representativeQueries: list every JSON endpoint on aadhar.sh
where is the photo manifest for aadhar.sh
which URL returns the current playlist as JSON
